description: Coins trending on CoinGecko in the last 24 hours, by search volume — a heartbeat for "what's hot in crypto right now". No parameters. Returns trending coins with rank, USD price, and 24h change. (Upstream reports market cap and volume as pre-formatted display strings, not numbers, so those are omitted rather than presented as numeric data.)
name: coingecko_get_trending

coins.description: Trending coins ranked by CoinGecko search volume. Data provided by CoinGecko.

id.description: CoinGecko slug — chain into other tools.

priceBtc.description: Current price in BTC, when available.

priceChangePercentage24hUsd.description: 24-hour USD price change percentage, when available.

priceUsd.description: Current price in USD, when available.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `rate_limited`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 429 — the shared keyless pool is throttled, or the Demo-tier quota was hit. `upstream_invalid_params`: CoinGecko rejected the request parameters with HTTP 400. `upstream_validation_failed`: CoinGecko rejected request validation with HTTP 422. `upstream_unauthorized`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 401, including credential or historical-window restrictions. `upstream_forbidden`: CoinGecko denied access with HTTP 402 or 403. `upstream_not_found`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 404 on an endpoint without a domain-specific missing result. `upstream_invalid_request`: CoinGecko rejected the HTTP request with another permanent client status or redirect. `upstream_conflict`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 409, 423, or 424. `upstream_timeout`: A CoinGecko attempt timed out or returned HTTP 408, 425, or 504. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: The coin-detail request, conditional currency lookup, and their retries exceeded one 50-second deadline. `upstream_deadline`: An externally supplied deadline expired during the CoinGecko exchange. `upstream_http_error`: CoinGecko returned permanent HTTP 501 Not Implemented. `upstream_unreachable`: CoinGecko was unreachable or returned a transient 5xx/HTML error after all retry attempts. `invalid_response`: CoinGecko returned a body that could not be parsed as JSON. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nftCount.description: Number of trending NFTs upstream also reported (detail not surfaced by this tool).

title: coingecko-mcp-server: get trending
